title: Maple-Sugar Shack Friendsgiving Couple
promptText: Transform the uploaded adult couple reference photo into an original Canadian autumn Friendsgiving portrait while preserving both people’s exact identities, ages, skin tones, facial proportions, hairstyles, body types, and affectionate connection; keep exactly two principal subjects. Style them in layered practical fall clothing—one in a rust wool overshirt and cream turtleneck, the other in a moss quilted jacket and wide-leg denim—with no visible brands. Place them outside a rustic maple-sugar shack at golden hour, setting a small outdoor table with enamel mugs, bread, apples, and a simple pie while red and gold leaves glow around them. Capture a candid shared smile as they arrange the table, with natural hands and believable food. Use a 50mm lens, backlit foliage, subtle warm fill, realistic wool, denim, wood, and skin, restrained maple-rust-moss color grade, soft cinematic depth, and cozy editorial realism. No national stereotypes, text, logos, watermark, added people, fused hands, altered faces, or oversaturated leaves. Exact 3:4 vertical composition.
